activity_summary: At one you said you will not write better this year, and then you told yourself not to say that. You slept at home. You did not stay up to praise the page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the boast, refused it, and went to bed.

facets.activity: Stopped the praise and slept at home

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I'll not write better this year
